## Description

Performs hierarchical clustering and risk parity allocation directly on the Riemannian manifold of Symmetric Positive Definite covariance matrices, avoiding Euclidean distance distortions.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional multi-asset portfolio construction, hierarchical risk parity allocation across asset classes.

## Vehicles

Risk-Parity Funds, Institutional Endowment Portfolios, Multi-Asset Allocators.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, asset class taxonomy labels.

## Caveats

Requires Riemannian geometry logarithmic and exponential map calculations for cluster distance metrics.
